description: Amazon products from search words or links on 14 marketplaces (US, UK, DE, FR, IT, ES, CA, IN, JP, AU, MX, BR, NL, AE): title, ASIN, price, list price, rating, ratings count, bought last month and sponsored flag. With details on: brand, features, specs, images, best sellers rank and seller. Filter by rating and price. Useful for price checks, product research and competitor tracking. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/amazon-products on your Apify account (about $0.001 per search result, or $0.0025 per product with full details; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

include_details.description: Open each product page for brand, features, specs and seller (extra cost per product).

links.description: Amazon product or search links, or ASINs.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 1000). Cost scales with this.

max_price.description: Highest price to keep, in the marketplace currency.

min_rating.description: Lowest star rating to keep, e.g. 4.

pages_per_search.description: Result pages to read per search.

queries.description: Search words as typed on Amazon, e.g. ["wireless earbuds"].

name: get_amazon_products

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Get products from Amazon (14 marketplaces)
